integrity: Proof supported by directly runnable finite cross-checks. No independent external priority validation or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only equations with finitely many variables in the bounded lattice and unary dual-negation language, evaluated uniformly over finite nontrivial Boolean lattices equipped with bijective dual lattice automorphisms. Nonbijective negation, non-Boolean lattices, and arbitrary first-order formulas excluded. The exact optimization algorithm terminates but has no asserted efficient complexity. Earlier equivalent formulations in symbolic dynamics or Ockham logic may exist.
title: Exact optimal satisfiability gaps for finite Boolean Ockham automorphisms
